name: labor-edu-forge
description: 面向师范生与新教师的劳动教育备课工作台

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c blue,red "npm run dev -w @labor-edu-forge/client" "npm run dev -w @labor-edu-forge/server"
scripts.dev:e2e: concurrently -n client,server -c blue,red "cross-env VITE_API_TARGET=http://127.0.0.1:37857 npm run dev -w @labor-edu-forge/client -- --port 5174" "cross-env PORT=37857 npm run dev:e2e -w @labor-edu-forge/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @labor-edu-forge/shared && npm run build -w @labor-edu-forge/client && npm run build -w @labor-edu-forge/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @labor-edu-forge/shared && npm run typecheck -w @labor-edu-forge/client && npm run typecheck -w @labor-edu-forge/server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
